headline: Jailer 2 is expected to reach about 23.5K tickets today, with the busiest hour ahead at 5–6 PM (1.2K).
bullets: Jailer 2 has sold 13.8K tickets so far today, and the full day is forecast at 23.5K (range 19.5K to 27.6K), which is 4% above yesterday.
Sales for the next hours are expected at 1.1K to 1.2K per hour, with the busiest hour ahead at 5–6 PM (1.2K, range 949 to 1.4K).
Today is Diwali (Sun 8 Nov), and Mon 9 Nov is a weekday, with tickets expected at 12.2K (range 7.8K to 18.4K), a wide range.
The film is in its later weeks, 24 days after its Thu 15 Oct release. No review or word-of-mouth signals are switched on for it, so these are estimates from the usual trend alone.
watch: Whether actual sales in the 4–5 PM hour come in near the 1.1K estimate, or toward the low (1K) or high (1.3K) end.
Whether the 5–6 PM and 6–7 PM hours land near the top (1.4K) or bottom (902 to 949) of their ranges.
